title: Audit: rest.ts Hit Dice recovery uses Math.max(1, floor(max/2)) floor
description: packages/core/src/state/rest.ts:717 restores Math.max(1, floor(diceMaximum/2)) Hit Dice. This is a Hit Dice pool count, not an HP increment, so it was out of scope for A2-F4. Check it against SRD long-rest text (regain half the max Hit Dice, minimum 1 per SRD rule if one exists) and document or fix.
